name: ISO 5457 drawing sheet sizes and layout
source: ISO 5457:1999 Technical product documentation - Sizes and layout of drawing sheets (with ISO 5457:1999/Amd 1:2010, whose text was not seen); A-series sizes from ISO 216
verifiedFrom: https://law.resource.org/pub/in/bis/S01/is.10711.2001.pdf (IS 10711:2001, identical with ISO 5457:1999: clauses 3 to 5, Tables 1 and 2, Figures 1 to 6)
sizesSource: ISO 5457:1999, 3.1 and Table 1 (trimmed sheet a1 x b1, drawing space a2 x b2 with tolerance +-0.5, untrimmed sheet a3 x b3 with tolerance +-2); orientation from 4.1; fields from 4.4 and Table 2. width and height are given as the sheet is used (A0 to A3 landscape, A4 portrait).
frameMarginsSource: ISO 5457:1999, 4.2: 'The border shall be 20 mm wide on the left edge, including the frame. It can be used as a filing margin. All other borders are 10 mm wide.' Table 1 drawing-space sizes agree (trimmed - 30 by trimmed - 20).
frameLineWidthSource: ISO 5457:1999, 4.2: the frame limiting the drawing space shall be continuous lines of 0,7 mm width.

zoneField.from: the axes of symmetry of the trimmed sheet (the centring marks); the remainder of the division is added to the fields at the corners
zoneField.rows: capital letters from the top downwards, I and O not used
zoneField.labelsOn: both sides of the sheet; for A4 only at the top and the right side
zoneField.labelLettering: vertical characters according to ISO 3098 (MechPilot uses type B vertical)
zoneField.source: ISO 5457:1999, 4.4 and Table 2 (number of fields: A0 24 x 16, A1 16 x 12, A2 12 x 8, A3 8 x 6, A4 6 x 4, long side x short side)

centringMarks.position: at the ends of the two axes of symmetry of the trimmed sheet, symmetry tolerance 1 mm
centringMarks.recommendation: continuous lines starting at the grid reference border and extending 10 mm beyond the drawing frame (into the drawing space); the form may be chosen freely

trimmingMarks.form: two overlapping rectangles, 10 mm x 5 mm, in the borders at the four corners of the trimmed sheet

titleBlock.position: A0 to A3: bottom right-hand corner of the drawing space; A4: the shorter (lower) part of the drawing space. The drawing reads in the direction of the title block.
titleBlock.source: ISO 5457:1999, 4.1 (layout of the title block itself: ISO 7200, see library/title-blocks/iso-7200.json)

sizeDesignation.position: in the bottom border at the right corner

notes: Elongated sizes (e.g. A3.1 = short side of A3 with the long side of A1) should be avoided (ISO 5457:1999, 3.2, Figure 3); MechPilot does not offer them.

ISO 5457:1999/Amd 1:2010 allows A4 in both horizontal and vertical position according to DIN Media's summary of DIN EN ISO 5457 (changes Table 1, Figure 1 and 4.1 per Austrian Standards). The amendment's text was not seen, so A4 landscape is not in `sizes`; see docs/to-verify.md.

The width of the grid reference border (the strip between the frame and the trimmed edge that carries the letters and numerals) is drawn in Figure 4 but not stated in the text; it is left out (docs/to-verify.md).
Sheets larger than A0 need extra centring marks at the mid-point of each section to be filmed (4.3); MechPilot offers A0 to A4 only.
